name: Kotoko-chan wa Chotto Hen.
original_name: 琴子ちゃんはちょっと変。
source:
Diligent and shy Kotoko Haruyama has a lot of expectations riding on her.
Burdened by stress, she develops a strange habit.

That is, whenever she realizes someone is looking at her lewdly, she reciprocates just a little, somewhat erotically...

But her strange little habit gets bolder and bolder and... she eventually falls prey to the ploys of perverted men...

==========================================

She was tired of trying so hard every day,

(If only I could... just for a moment... be someone else...)

She thought that these men, with their perverted gazes, would be able to see her in a different light than usual...

Slowly, she becomes interested in the fervent gazes and carnal desires of these men...

...and eventually, gives her body up to them willingly.

A janitor, a molester, a homeless man, the loner classmate, an exchange student...

And so on and so forth...

These filthy and selfish men, filled with disgusting desires will have their way with Kotoko's body, doing as they please...

勤奋又害羞的春山琴子肩负着众人的期待。压力沉重的她养成了一个奇怪的习惯：每当发现有人用色眯眯的目光看她，她就会稍微用带点情色意味的方式回应……然而，这个奇怪的小习惯越来越大胆……最终，她落入了变态男人的圈套……

（要是我能……哪怕只有一会儿……成为别人就好了……）
